name: Exp_EF_distance
summary: This EA trades based on the EF_distance indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement to detect trend direction. It opens buy positions when the EF_distance values indicate an upward trend (Value[0]>Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell positions when they indicate a downward trend, with an optional Flat-Trend volatility filter in the full version.
summary_zh: 该EA基于EF_distance指标进行交易，该指标衡量价格运动的效率来检测趋势方向。当EF_distance值显示上升趋势时开多仓，显示下降趋势时开空仓，完整版还包含Flat-Trend波动率过滤器。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于EF_distance指标，该指标通过计算价格移动的效率来衡量趋势强度和方向。入场条件为：做多时要求EF_distance的前两个值递减（Value[1]<Value[2]）且当前值回升（Value[0]>Value[1]），同时完整版要求Flat-Trend波动率指标值大于等于设定的波动率阈值；做空则相反。出场条件通过反向信号触发，即做多持仓时出现做空信号则平多仓，做空持仓时出现做多信号则平空仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，但没有动态调整止损止盈或追踪止损的机制。完整版(exp_ef_distance.mq5)额外引入了Flat-Trend指标作为波动率过滤器，只有在市场波动率足够时才允许开仓，提高了信号质量。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the EF_distance indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement to determine trend strength and direction. Entry conditions for buy positions require the EF_distance values to show a descending pattern over the prior two bars (Value[1]<Value[2]) with the current bar reversing upward (Value[0]>Value[1]), and the full version additionally requires the Flat-Trend volatility indicator to meet or exceed the configured volatility threshold. Sell entry conditions are the mirror opposite, requiring an ascending pattern that reverses downward. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals — a long position is closed when a sell signal appears and vice versa, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, but there is no dynamic adjustment of stop-loss, take-profit, or trailing stop mechanism. The full version (exp_ef_distance.mq5) adds the Flat-Trend indicator as a volatility filter, only allowing entries when market volatility is sufficient, which improves signal quality.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management percentage for lot calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

parameters.name: StDev_Method
parameters.description: 标准差平滑方法(完整版)

parameters.name: StDevLength
parameters.description: 标准差平滑深度(完整版)

parameters.name: StDevPhase
parameters.description: 标准差平滑参数(完整版)

parameters.name: Volatil
parameters.description: 执行交易的波动率大小(完整版)
parameters.description_en: Volatility threshold for trade execution (full version)

pros: 完整版结合波动率过滤器，避免在低波动震荡行情中频繁开仓
使用新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar），避免同一根K线内重复交易
提供买入/卖出和平仓的独立开关，灵活性高
支持按存款比例自动计算手数，有助于资金管理
双指标确认机制降低虚假信号
pros_en: Full version combines a volatility filter to avoid frequent entries in low-volatility choppy markets
Uses new bar detection (CIsNewBar) to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar
Provides independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing, offering high flexibility
Supports automatic lot sizing based on deposit share, aiding money management
Dual-indicator confirmation mechanism reduces false signals
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，不根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在不同行情下可能不合适
缺少追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能在回撤中损失大部分利润
没有点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能导致滑点损失
EF_distance指标逻辑不透明，参数优化缺乏直觉引导
信号生成逻辑较简单，仅依赖3个K线的指标值比较，可能产生频繁的假反转信号
cons_en: Stop-loss and take-profit are fixed points without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (ATR), which may be inappropriate across varying market conditions
Lacks a trailing stop mechanism, so profitable positions may give back most gains during pullbacks
No spread filter, which can lead to slippage losses on instruments with wide spreads
EF_distance indicator logic is opaque, making parameter optimization lack intuitive guidance
Signal generation logic is simplistic, relying on comparison of only 3 bars of indicator values, which may produce frequent false reversal signals
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应市场波动
增加追踪止损功能，保护已有盈利不被大幅回撤侵蚀
增加点差和滑点过滤，避免在点差过大时开仓
增加最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤保护，防止极端行情下的过度亏损
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop-loss/take-profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt risk management to market volatility
Add a trailing stop feature to protect accumulated profits from significant pullbacks
Add spread and slippage filters to avoid opening positions when spreads are excessively wide
Add maximum position count limits and maximum drawdown protection to prevent excessive losses in extreme market conditions

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不随市场波动调整，在低波动时止损过大，高波动时止盈过小
缺少追踪止损，盈利仓位可能大幅回撤至亏损
没有点差过滤和最大回撤保护机制
MM参数为负值时使用固定手数，小账户可能导致过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit does not adapt to market volatility — stop may be too wide in low volatility and take-profit too small in high volatility
Lacks trailing stop, so winning positions can retrace significantly into loss territory
No spread filter or maximum drawdown protection mechanism
When MM parameter is negative (fixed lot), small accounts may result in excessive leverage
